line_text: Hail! You find your treasure? Heh...no, there's little out there but shifting sand and hot sun... / Still, people rarely visit the sandsea... Unusual to see people out here... We're trying to catch us some sandfish, but they're not biting. / Why have you come to such a place? You seem to be adventurers, yes... Surely, you did not come to hunt treasure in the Valley of the Dead! / The Valley of the Dead? Treasure hunter or no, you'd best avoid that place. 'Less you care to tangle with an avion most fell! line_text: A construct to draw oil from the ground. / Abandoned many years now, it seems.

speaker: Vaan
line_text: Did Dalmascans build this?

speaker: Basch
line_text: No. The Rozarrians. / Their empire lies far to the west, ever at war with Archadia.

speaker: Basch
line_text: Heedless of the kingdoms caught in their midst. / Dalmasca. Nabradia. Landis.

speaker: Vossler
line_text: 'Tis the small craft's fate: to watch the list of the galleons and pray for light winds.

speaker: Basch
line_text: Vossler! / Why are you here?

speaker: Vossler
line_text: Imagine my surprise... / when upon my return to Bhujerba, I find both you and the Lady Ashe have vanished.

speaker: Vossler
line_text: I thought you above consorting with sky pirates.

speaker: Basch
line_text: Balthier is a man worthy of our trust. And it was the Lady Ashe's decision.

speaker: Basch
line_text: I am content to lend my arm.

speaker: Basch
line_text: As I could not when Rasler died, when her throne was taken.

speaker: Basch
line_text: Never again. I will defend her this time.

speaker: Vossler
line_text: You walk the knight's path. / The Lady Ashe?

speaker: Fran
line_text: We should leave this place.

speaker: Balthier
line_text: Let me guess: sandstorm?

speaker: Fran
line_text: Something far worse.

speaker: Vossler
line_text: I see... / So the Dawn Shard does lie in King Raithwall's tomb.

speaker: Vossler
line_text: The Marquis sympathizes with your plight, yet the Empire perches as a carrion bird on his shoulder.

speaker: Vossler
line_text: He can keep whispers of your "abduction" silent for only so long.

speaker: Ashe
line_text: Yes, but tell me, Vossler, what have you accomplished?

speaker: Balthier
line_text: We leave at once!

speaker: Balthier
line_text: This is Urutan-Yensa territory... / and they are unfond of visitors.

speaker: Balthier
line_text: Looks like we've attracted the wrong sort of attention. / Let's quit this place while we still can. / Move!

speaker: Ashe
line_text: Vossler! / Have you found the means to restore Dalmasca?

speaker: Vossler
line_text: First, we must claim the Dawn Shard. / It all begins with that.
